title: l1qw.32(b) remainder: /config/privacy + /config/privacy/allowed C resources
description: Remainder of ulum (l1qw.32(b)) after the 4.01-body slice landed: coap_config.c (or a sibling resource) must expose /config/privacy (GET mode) and /config/privacy/allowed (PUT {peers:[...]}) replacing the single-peer whitelist in the C coap subsystem, with host tests in lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon (now buildable again after the Kconfig fix in upk4). Coordinate the body shapes with l1qw.32(a) Python.
close_reason: Landed: /config/privacy + /config/privacy/allowed C resources per spec 18.2.4 (l1qw.32(b) remainder). (1) Allowed-peer IID store in coap_location.c (LICHEN_POSITION_ALLOWED_PEERS_MAX 8, position_cache_mutex-guarded) with set/get/count/check APIs and lichen_position_privacy_mode() getter. (2) GET /config/privacy emits {mode: <name>, allowed: [bstr(8) IIDs]}; PUT /config/privacy/allowed decodes {peers: [bstr(8)]} via a strict hand-rolled CBOR reader (map/text/array/bstr heads validated, multi-digit heads rejected, r.pos==r.len trailing-bytes check, count==0 restores deny-all). (3) Host tests: PUT replace + store reflection, GET body byte-structure asserts, malformed 3-byte-IID rejection (4.00, list unchanged), empty-list deny-all restoration. (4) prj.conf COAP_SERVER/RING_BUFFER/TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR fixes so the dir builds (upk4 territory). Verified: native_sim suite 15/15 green. 3x reviews (kimi-k3) caught and I fixed in-revision: leftover PROBE printk on the security path (unauthenticated log-spam + committed debug code — removed), dead cbor_peek_type (removed), count==0 rejection blocking deny-all restoration (access-control defect — now allowed), missing trailing-bytes strictness (added r.pos==r.len), test-list state leak across tests (harness resets via allowed_set(NULL,0)). Noted non-defects: fragment-style PaOrdering aliasing consistent; TOCTOU on the mode string is cosmetic. Read-gate integration of the list into GROUP/PRIVATE position reads remains with the parent l1qw.32 pending the Python (a) mirror.
